answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: The activation profile fits fine-tuning better than the other categories. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, below every category (quantized 0.096+, fine-tuned 0.086+, system-prompted 0.113+). The layer-2 spike is 0.2, which rules out system-prompting (31.7+) and is below the quantized range too. The difference grows steadily to 0.551 at layer 32, which is large and typical of an adapter change rather than quantization's flat profile. Effective rank 3.89 and direction consistency 0.614 sit between quantized and fine-tuned, but the consistency is within the fine-tuned range. Refusals added (8, versus 0 to 4 in the document) and short replies (25%) point to a behavior shift from weight changes. Median first divergence is 1 and edit distance 0.758, closer to system-prompted, but the missing layer-2 spike and tiny layer-1 difference argue against it. Top-1 agreement of 0.842 and KL of 0.551 are beyond the fine-tuned range, so this is likely a stronger fine-tune than the document's examples. Quantized is ruled out by the large logit and activation changes. Base is ruled out because the differences are non-zero.
